metadata.notes: We don't mean to repeat outselves, but...  29 Across: Other KEVIN Smith films include Clerks and Chasing Amy.  Smith himself plays the enigmatic and comical character Silent Bob in many of his films. 56 Down: FUTURE is from the Latin futurus, which is the future participle of the familiar crossword answer esse, "to be". 112 Down: John Lennon was shot in from of the Dakota, the residential hotel on West 72nd Street in Manhattan where Yoko ONO still maintains an apartment.
